transcript: NM_003159.3 (presumed MANE Select, isoform hCDKL5_1) — UNVERIFIED in this session; no retrieval tool was available. Must be confirmed, along with exon count and alternative-first-exon (1/1a/1b) naming, before any exon-level work.
defect: An unspecified loss-of-function allele in X-linked CDKL5 removes functional CDKL5 kinase from one allele; because CDD is overwhelmingly a heterozygous-female disease with X inactivation, roughly half of neurons also silence the healthy allele, so the net defect is mosaic haploinsufficiency of full-length CDKL5 protein rather than a single aberrant transcript. There is no defined splice lesion, no shared mutant mRNA species, and no single canonical exon carrying the lesion.
desired_rna_product: Increased absolute abundance of full-length, productive, protein-coding CDKL5 mRNA with the unaltered MANE coding sequence, produced from the intact wild-type allele in neurons — no engineered exon deletion, no frame change, no truncated or chimeric product. Achieved either by redirecting non-productive CDKL5 transcripts (poison-exon inclusion / intron retention / NMD-destined isoforms) into the productive mRNA, or by relieving X-inactivation silencing of the wild-type allele. Target an upregulation window with a bounded upper limit, since CDKL5 overexpression is itself a liability; mutant-allele transcripts are left untouched.
